text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Between researching races and gathering 
data... lately, I might have been getting 
a little too absorbed in my trainer 
duties. As I rubbed my sleep-deprived 
eyes—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, leave all that exhaustion to me, 
please!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I shall become your prince!
choice_data_list: A prince...? W-Why...?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yesterday, I watched a movie with 
Dia-chan! And the prince in it gave his 
partner such an elegant escort!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
A special moment spent with a prince... I 
thought if you could spend time like that 
too, Trainer, it might help you unwind...!
choice_data_list: I-I see...?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Anyway, leave it to me! I'll make sure 
our next day off is a wonderful day!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
—First up is afternoon tea! Let's relax in 
a shop with a nice atmosphere!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"In the movies, the prince picks out the 
perfect black tea for his partner so they 
can have the most wonderful teatime, you 
know?"
choice_data_list: Then maybe I'll leave the ordering to you.

Then perhaps I'll leave the ordering to 
you.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes♪ ...Excuse me, waiter. Two 
Darjeelings, please.

text_block_list.name: Waiter
text_block_list.text:
Certainly. In that case, which tea leaves 
would you prefer?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Ahhh! Come to think of it, weren't 
there all sorts of Darjeeling teas...!?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Lumbini Tea Estate...? Sungma Tea 
Estate...?? U-Umm, how did Dia-chan order 
it again...!?"

text_block_list.name: Waiter
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... Right now, I would recommend 
Barasun Tea Estate. It has a soft, sweet 
finish, so I am certain your companion 
will enjoy it as well.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
A-Ahaha... Thank you very much. I'll take 
two of those, then...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Wah, freshly baked scones! Mmm, smells so 
good...♪
choice_data_list: ...Yeah! It's gently sweet and delicious!
...Yeah! It's gently sweet and delicious!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Really!? In that case... please eat my 
portion too!
choice_data_list: Huh!? But I thought you loved sweets...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm totally fine! I just want you to 
feel happy, Trainer!
choice_data_list: I-Is that so? Well, if you say so—
O-Oh, really? If you say so, then—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
choice_data_list:
...Actually, I'm full, so could you eat 
this for me?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hau?! U-Uuu... Sorry, then... If you 
really don't mind~...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Um, how about going shopping at a luxury 
department store next?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I want to pick out clothes that suit you, 
Trainer... Just like a prince from a 
movie!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her desire to comfort me comes through 
clearly. However, she also looked like she 
was pushing herself through unfamiliar 
methods. ...In that case—
choice_data_list:
Let's go somewhere you can relax more than 
anywhere else
Let's go somewhere you can relax the most.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huh? M-Me...?
choice_data_list:
I'd like you to escort me like a prince 
there.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Understood! If that's what you wish... 
I'll guide you to my personal relaxation 
spot!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ta-da! What do you think of this nature 
park? Mmh, so many lively voices today as 
well!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Just relaxing here... and singing together 
with the kids. Just the other day, we were 
all singing in a chorus.
choice_data_list: I want to hear Kitasan sing.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"My singing...? Of course, if that's what 
you'd like! Well then—"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"A new beginning is here, they say~♪ I 
felt a sparkle right before my eyes~♪"
choice_data_list:
(…Such a soothing singing voice, as 
always)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Combined with fatigue from work, the 
comforting sound of her singing voice 
makes my eyelids heavy. I hurriedly shake 
my head, but—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... It's okay if you fall asleep, you 
know?
choice_data_list: But if we do that, you'll...
But if we do that, you'll...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I will... stay by your side and protect 
you while you are in your dreams.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
“...Did I sound a bit too cocky? But 
today, I'm gonna――”

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Because I am your prince, after all.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"The sky begins to turn toward tomorrow~♪ 
At my feet, the scent of blooming 
flowers~♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Before I knew it, I seemed to have 
drifted into a slumber. Feeling completely 
refreshed, I opened my eyes to find—"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Trainer. ...Did you sleep well?
choice_data_list:
Yeah. I guess it's all thanks to your 
singing.

Yeah. Maybe it's thanks to your singing 
voice.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, you think so? ...Well then—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Did I... manage to become a splendid 
prince?
choice_data_list:
You were the greatest prince in the whole 
world!

You were the greatest prince in the whole 
world!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ! Oh, Trainer, really... Ehehe♪
choice_data_list:
Can I ask for your help again when I'm 
tired?
Let me escort you this time.
Let me escort you this time.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ! Oh, Trainer, really... Ehehe♪
choice_data_list:
Can I ask for your help again when I'm 
tired?
Let me escort you this time.
Let me escort you this time.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Whenever you ask, Trainer, I'll always be 
your Prince Charming ready to save the 
day!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh!? Does that mean you want to act like 
a prince, Trainer...?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I'm sure it'll be wonderful... I'll 
be looking forward to it♪
